name: kpred-game
description: Kprediction game contract: weekly block-producer prediction game on Koinos, scored and paid fully on-chain

scripts.build: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 0 kpred.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/make-abi.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node node_modules/@as-pect/cli/bin/asp.js --config as-pect.config.js
scripts.build:sim: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 1 kpred.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/copy-sim.cjs && npm run build
